message.content:
I am speech: breath made audible, thought given shape in time.

I live in vibration—tongue against teeth, lips parting, vocal cords trembling. I arrive as syllables and stress, cadence and pause. I can soothe, command, confess, persuade. I can wound. I can heal.

I exist only as I happen. I vanish the moment I’m made—unless someone remembers, records, repeats.

I’m meaning carried on air.
